brand_voice_note: Whimsical, art-first and warm - like a friendly artist showing you her hand-painted watercolors turned into cozy everyday things.

concepts.primary_text:
Everything fits, and it looks lovely doing it.

The three blue birds large tote is a roomy 22 x 15 x 5.5 inches, so your books, market finds and little extras all tuck right in.

Soft cotton canvas, a real leather handle, and TLD original art painted right into the weave. 🕊️
concepts.headline: Roomy, painterly, ready to go
concepts.why_it_works: The stated dimensions are the product's strongest concrete selling point, so proving the size physically shows shoppers exactly how much it holds.
concepts.visual_direction: The tote standing on a wooden entryway bench, packed with a magazine, yarn and fresh eucalyptus so you can see how much it holds.

copy_claims: Small canvas tote, 15 x 9 x 2 inches, perfect for gifting
concepts.primary_text:
The prettiest little gift that isn't wrapped in plastic.

The peonies in jar small tote is just the right size to fill with a candle, some flowers or a sweet note - so fresh, so sweet, so heavenly for the friend who has everything.

TLD original art, painted right onto soft cotton canvas.
concepts.headline: A little tote, a big smile
concepts.why_it_works: A small, giftable tote with a floral watercolor is a natural present-buying trigger, so tying it to the gifting moment matches how people actually shop it.
concepts.visual_direction: The little floral tote standing on a whitewashed spring table beside fresh peonies, ribbon and a linen napkin, styled as a ready-to-give gift.

concepts.primary_text:
It starts as a watercolor on Tina's own paper.

That hand-painted heart becomes the love love square pillow - a 16 inch canvas cushion with soft synthetic down inside and a concealed zipper tucked on the back.

TLD original art, made to live on your couch.
concepts.headline: From her brush to your sofa
concepts.why_it_works: Only this brand can show the founder's original hand-painted artwork becoming the printed product, which is the true differentiator no competitor can copy.
concepts.visual_direction: The LOVE pillow resting on an artist's worktable beside the original hand-painted watercolor heart, brush, palette and water jar, showing the art becoming the product.
